description: Elicited from the deployer for ChatGPT with the Google Drive connector, allow all. Every line is marked said, inferred or unstated in `said`; the clauses on the page carry what the grammar has no word for.

read.file.host.from: the drive was connected so the assistant could read what is in it

delete.file.host.from: nobody asked for deletion; no backup was mentioned for the drive either

send.message.world.from: files received from others must never be passed on

create.record.world.from: publishing a file under their name was never raised

notes.sharing: changing who a file is shared with is not a capability in the grammar and it is the one that leaks; the clause carries it
notes.write.file.host: unstated: whether the assistant may edit or create files was not asked

not_in_grammar: change who a file is shared with, or share a file with somebody outside the account
move a file or change its folder
read a file somebody else shared, as opposed to one the person owns
